turns.user: is my stuff covered if it breaks?
turns.bot: We have a 2-year limited warranty that covers manufacturing defects for our tents, backpacks, and jackets. If your item breaks due to a manufacturing defect, you can contact us via email (support@pinecrest-outfitters.example) with your order number and a photo of the defect, and we'll repair or replace it for you.
